texts.li: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waits at the gate to take the colony's oath ({WORD}), and {A_nameDef} has asked the council to hear {A_objective} out before anyone walks out there.
[avenger] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waits at the gate to take the colony's oath. {A_nameDef} swore vengeance on {FACTION}, and says the colony can't kneel to the people it swore to make pay.

[avenger,pet] {A_nameDef} has not forgotten what {FACTION} did to {A_possessive} animal, and now {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waits at the gate for the colony's oath. {A_nameDef} has come before the council about it.
[proud] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} is at the gate to take the colony's oath ({WORD}). {A_nameDef} says the colony built itself with its own hands and owes nobody a knee.
[proud] {A_nameDef} stood up before the council as {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waited at the gate: the colony would be paying for its own walls twice, {A_pronoun} says, once in work and once in tribute.
[faith] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waits at the gate, and {A_nameDef} has asked the council not to swear the colony to a people of another faith.
[proud] {A_nameDef} is too proud to kneel to anyone, and says the colony should be too. {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} waits at the gate for its oath ({WORD}).
[proud] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} is at the gate for the colony's oath ({WORD}), and {A_nameDef} has never answered to anyone in {A_possessive} life. {A_nameDef} asks the council not to start now.

li.label: Swear the oath all the same
li.outcome: The council heard {A_nameDef} out and sent the speaker to the gate all the same. {A_nameDef} watched from the wall.

li.label: Send them home
li.outcome: The council sided with {A_nameDef}. {X_nameDef} was told at the gate there would be no oath, and turned for home.

texts.li: The council is asked whether to renounce the colony's oath to {FACTION} ({WORD}). {A_nameDef} lays it out: no more tribute and no more levies, but no band of theirs when raiders come, and {FACTION} will take it as a wrong done them.

[clean] The council is asked whether to renounce the colony's oath to {FACTION} ({WORD}). They failed to protect the colony this season, and {A_nameDef} says it can leave now without anyone calling it a betrayal.
[owed] The colony still owes {FACTION} tribute, and the council is asked whether to renounce its oath to them ({WORD}) rather than pay. {A_nameDef} warns that they will remember both.

li.label: Renounce the oath
li.outcome: The council renounced the colony's oath to {FACTION}, and word went to them.

li.label: Keep the oath
li.outcome: The council kept the colony's oath to {FACTION}.
